input:
Subject: Interested in your enterprise plan
Body: Hi I came across your platform and I am interested in the enterprise pricing plan. Can you share details on what is included and how many users are supported? We are a team of 50 people.

Subject: Request for a product demo
Body: Hello we are evaluating several SaaS solutions for our company and would love to schedule a live demo of your platform. Please let us know your availability this week.

Subject: Can we get a custom quote?
Body: We have around 200 employees and need a solution that supports SSO and custom integrations. Can you provide a custom pricing quote for our requirements?

Subject: Upgrade from Starter to Pro
Body: I am currently on the Starter plan and want to upgrade to the Pro plan. What are the steps and will there be any data migration required?

Subject: Do you offer nonprofit discounts?
Body: We are a registered nonprofit organization. Do you offer any special pricing or discounts for nonprofits? Please let us know.

Subject: Reseller partnership inquiry
Body: I represent a technology reseller and am interested in becoming a certified reseller of your product. Can you connect me with your partnerships team?

Subject: Annual plan vs monthly billing
Body: Can you explain the difference in pricing between monthly billing and annual billing? Is there a significant discount for going annual?

Subject: Free trial extension request
Body: My free trial ends tomorrow and I have not had enough time to evaluate the product properly. Is it possible to extend the trial by 7 more days?

Subject: How do I reset my password?
Body: I tried to log in today but I cannot remember my password. The reset email does not seem to be arriving in my inbox. Can you help me reset it?

Subject: Dashboard not loading
Body: The main dashboard is not loading for me since this morning. I see a blank white screen after login. I have tried clearing cache and using a different browser but the issue persists.

Subject: Unable to export reports
Body: I am trying to export my monthly report as a PDF but the download button does not respond when I click it. I need this report urgently for a meeting.

Subject: Login page keeps timing out
Body: Every time I enter my credentials the login page spins for a while and then shows a timeout error. I can only sometimes get in after multiple attempts.

Subject: Email notifications not working
Body: I configured email notifications for new activity but I am not receiving any emails. I have checked spam and confirmed the email address is correct.

Subject: Two-factor authentication issues
Body: My authenticator app is not accepting the OTP codes for 2FA. I cannot log into my account at all. This is very urgent for me.

Subject: Search functionality broken
Body: The search bar on the platform returns no results for any query I type even for items I can clearly see in the list. It was working fine last week.

Subject: How to invite team members?
Body: I want to add 5 new users to our workspace. Can you guide me through the process of sending invites and assigning roles?

Subject: What integrations do you support?
Body: We use Slack Salesforce and Jira in our workflow. Does your platform integrate natively with these tools? If yes how do I set them up?

Subject: How does data backup work?
Body: Can you explain how data backups are handled on your platform? How often are backups taken and how can we restore data if needed?

Subject: Is there an API available?
Body: We are looking to build a custom integration using your API. Is there developer documentation available? What authentication method does the API use?

Subject: What are the data storage limits?
Body: We are planning to store large amounts of data in your platform. What are the storage limits per plan and what happens if we exceed the limit?

Subject: GDPR compliance question
Body: We are based in the EU and need to ensure full GDPR compliance. Can you confirm your platform is GDPR compliant and provide a Data Processing Agreement?

Subject: What is your uptime SLA?
Body: We need a guaranteed uptime SLA for our business operations. What uptime percentage do you guarantee and what compensation is offered for downtime?

Subject: Mobile app availability
Body: Does your platform have a mobile app for iOS and Android? We have field staff who need access on the go.

Subject: Duplicate charge on my account
Body: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. I see two identical transactions on my bank statement. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.

Subject: Invoice not received
Body: My billing cycle ended 5 days ago but I have not received my invoice via email. I need it for accounting purposes. Can you send it again?

Subject: Wrong plan charged
Body: I downgraded from Pro to Starter last month but I was still charged the Pro plan amount. Please correct this and refund the difference.

Subject: Request for annual invoice
Body: We need a consolidated annual invoice for our finance team for the full year 2024. Can you generate and send this to billing@ourcompany.com?

Subject: Cancel subscription
Body: I would like to cancel my subscription effective immediately. Please confirm the cancellation and let me know if there are any outstanding charges.

Subject: Update billing email
Body: Our finance contact has changed. Please update the billing email from old@company.com to finance@company.com for all future invoices.

Subject: Tax exemption certificate
Body: We are a tax-exempt organization. How do I submit our tax exemption certificate to remove tax charges from future invoices?

Subject: Refund request for unused period
Body: I cancelled my annual subscription last week after only 2 months of use. I would like a prorated refund for the remaining 10 months. Is that possible?

Subject: Error code 500 when saving form
Body: Every time I try to save a record in the contacts module I get a 500 Internal Server Error. This happens 100% of the time. Steps: login go to contacts click new save. See attached screenshot.

Subject: Data export producing empty file
Body: When I use the bulk export feature the downloaded CSV file is always empty even though there is clearly data in the system. This started happening after your last update.

Subject: Incorrect date formatting in reports
Body: All dates in the reporting module are showing in MM-DD-YYYY format but our account is set to DD-MM-YYYY. The setting saves but does not apply to reports.

Subject: Notification badge shows wrong count
Body: The notification bell shows 15 unread notifications but when I open it there are only 3. The count does not reset even after reading all notifications.

Subject: Integration sync failing with error
Body: Our Salesforce integration keeps failing with error: INVALID_SESSION_ID. We have reconnected it 3 times but it fails again after a few hours. CRM sync is completely broken.

Subject: Bulk delete not working
Body: Selecting all records and clicking delete shows a success message but the records are still there after page refresh. Version: 3.2.1.

Subject: Chart rendering broken in Firefox
Body: All charts and graphs in the analytics module display as blank boxes in Firefox 120. They work fine in Chrome. This is a Firefox-specific rendering issue.

Subject: CRITICAL: All customer data inaccessible
Body: URGENT - We cannot access any of our customer data since 2 hours ago. The system shows all tables as empty. We have not deleted anything. This is affecting our entire operations. We have 500 active users who cannot work.

Subject: System has been compromised
Body: We believe our account has been hacked. We are seeing login activity from unknown IP addresses in Russia and China. Sensitive data may have been accessed. We need immediate assistance to secure our account.

Subject: Complete service outage for our team
Body: Our entire team of 80 users has been unable to access the platform for the past 3 hours. We are getting a 503 error on every page. Our business is completely halted. This is a P1 incident.

Subject: Unauthorized changes detected
Body: Someone has been modifying records in our system without authorization. We can see in the audit log that changes were made at 3am by a user who was not logged in. Possible security breach.

Subject: Database connection errors across all modules
Body: Every action we take results in a database connection error. We cannot create update or delete anything. The error says: Connection pool exhausted. This has been going on for 90 minutes.

Subject: Feature request: dark mode
Body: I would love to see a dark mode option added to the platform. Many of us work late hours and a dark theme would be much easier on the eyes.

Subject: Partnership opportunity
Body: I represent a consulting firm that works with mid-market companies. I believe there could be a great opportunity to refer your product to our clients. Who should I contact about a referral partnership?

Subject: Great product feedback
Body: I just wanted to say that our team has been using your platform for 6 months and we are very happy with it. The recent updates to the reporting module were excellent. Keep up the great work.

Subject: Request for case study participation
Body: Our company has had great results using your platform. We would be happy to participate in a case study or provide a testimonial. Please reach out if you are interested.

Subject: Requesting product roadmap
Body: Can you share your product roadmap for 2025? We are trying to plan our internal tooling strategy and it would help to know what features are coming.
